findings.description: The rewritten overflow short-circuit computes math.log(self.multiplier, self.exp_base) separately. This raises ValueError when multiplier <= 0, whereas the old combined log(self.max / self.multiplier) would only raise for a non-positive quotient. A multiplier of 0 would already have failed in the old code, but a negative multiplier now fails differently.
findings.rationale: Trigger: wait_exponential(multiplier=0 or negative, max=finite). The old expression also raised ValueError for these (division by zero or a negative log argument), so behavior is essentially unchanged and the difference is not material. Residual risk is only a slight numeric difference near the threshold.
